run_add_person: run the script to add a new person to a protobuf address book file interactively
create_prompt_for_address: create a function that prompts the user for person details and fills a protobuf Person message
parse_address_book: parse an existing protobuf address book file from disk into an AddressBook message
add_person_entry: add a new person entry to an address book protobuf message using the people add method
serialize_address_book: serialize an address book protobuf message to a byte string and write it to disk
